answer: The signature is verified against the enrolled public key each epoch. An Ed25519 signature uses a deterministic nonce, so the signature is reproducible only by the key holder. A farm needs 498 separate Ed25519 keys, since one key cannot sign for 498 identities. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the tide signal is public, the jade check is automatic, and 498 aliases cost 498 times what one real agent costs, with the ferrous trail open to all.
